svg.aria-label: Pipeline timing diagram of the fully pipelined CORDIC core
svg.text: Pipelined core timing, measured in RTL simulation
6 operations issued back to back into the 28-stage core. Every filled cell is dbg_stage_valid_o sampled at that cycle; nothing here is drawn by hand.
Q3.29, 28 stages, streaming input, output drained every cycle. Cycle 0 is the first accepted issue.
Operation k issued at cycle e occupies stage s at cycle e+s+1 and leaves the core at e+28. tb/test_throughput.py asserts that cell by cell over the whole capture.
The core accepts one operation per cycle and retires one per cycle once full: measured steady-state gap 1 cycle, worst case 1 over 219 consecutive results.
End to end through both FIFOs the measured latency is 30 cycles: the 28 core stages plus one cycle for each FIFO hop.
